provenance.license: NIED J-SHIS (防災科研 地震ハザードステーション) — government open data
provenance.note: rectangle fault-plane geometry (top-center + strike/dip/len/wid/topDepth + 3D corner polygon, [lng,lat,depthKm]) per ERC major-active-fault evaluation; the capital M7-class umbrella rate itself is NOT published per-fault by J-SHIS — this freeze carries GEOMETRY only

selectionRule.universe: every standalone F-code (regex ^F\d{6}$) in the Y2024 ltecode list; composite A-F suffix entries excluded (standalone segments tile the same surfaces; including both would double-count)
selectionRule.primary: any polygon vertex inside lat [34.9,36.25] x lng [139,140.45] (southern-Kanto M7-class domain operationalisation)
selectionRule.strict: any polygon vertex inside lat [35,36] x lng [139.2,140.4] (borderline-drop sensitivity subset)
selectionRule.weights: primary rate split = trace-length share (lenKm); equal split is the sensitivity arm (psha-capital-multigeo.js W2)
